scoring_justification: Ambient Raman frequencies compared to paper-reported gold; pressure trend checked by monotonicity and a key pressure point. Recomputing the full lattice dynamics is not feasible in the verifier, so result-level compare and structural audit are the strongest tiers.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold ambient Raman frequencies and pressure point value
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 2 (Ba A1g=105, Ba Eg=130, O(2) Eg=535, O(2) A1g=583) and text (O_A A1g at 0.6 GPa=587 cm^-1)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported computational results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's own published numbers for the reproduced quantities.

outputs.description: Ambient-pressure Raman-active phonon frequencies. Each row gives a mode label (e.g., 'Ba A1g') and its computed frequency in inverse centimeters.

Pressure dependence of the O_A A1g Raman mode frequency. Must contain frequency values at a series of pressures from 0 to 7.5 GPa, with strictly increasing frequency as pressure rises. A hidden check also verifies the frequency at a specific pressure.

output_contract.notes: Ambient frequencies are scored by comparing the computed values to hidden reference values within a tolerance. The pressure file is scored by checking that the frequency increases monotonically with pressure across all reported points, and that a hidden pressure point has the expected frequency (exact_match within tolerance).
